I was changing lanes on a multi-lane road in Katy, Texas, checking my mirror and signaling as I moved over. The
vehicle in the next lane came alongside me and its side made contact with the driver's side of my car. Both of our cars
were moving at normal highway speed, and the impact pusehd my vehicle toward the shoulder before I could bring it
under control and pull over safely. I have told this same account every time I have described what happened, whether
to the officer at the scene, to the other driver's insurer, or to the adjuster handling this file. I am the named driver on
this policy and was operating my own vehicle at the time. The collision left me with a back strain that caused stiffness
and soreness in the lower back for several days afterward. I sought medical attention to have it checked and am
